answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable bond released only after a slow, glacier-like vesting of verified work: one identity, one bond, so creating a thousand fake identities means locking a thousand bonds. A shared reputation graph works like a nebula of linked attestations, where new identities start dim and gain trust only through consistent, checkable contributions. A walnut-sized deposit alone is cheap, so combine it with rate limits on new identities so a Sybil flood cannot outpace honest verification.
